# Credit Risk Optimization Strategy 2026

This document details key strategic initiatives for the Credit & Loans department for the 2026 period.

## Strategic Objectives:

*   Optimize borrower credit score quarterly.
*   Monitor borrower credit score urgently.
*   Optimize default risk for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize collateral value for strategy 2026.
*   Investigate interest rates for strategy 2026.
